meta.scope: Hulu Langat, Sepang and Kuala Langat districts
meta.note: Malaysia's reticulated sewer network (IWK) is not open data, so almost no sewage pipelines are mapped in OpenStreetMap. This layer is the surface drainage network that actually conveys domestic sewage, greywater and urban run-off to the Langat River, plus the few mapped sewer assets.
